title: HireMind Structured Evidence Record v3 (extends Mervat v2)
description: Traceable CV and job-description evidence. Every record points to exact character offsets in the ORIGINAL text and carries span_sha256 so the pointer can be re-verified without storing the text. verbatim_text is present only in the private form. A requirement with no CV evidence is NOT a negative: see requirement_links in the pair record.

verbatim_text.description: Exact source text of the span. Present only in the PRIVATE form; the shareable file stores span_sha256 instead.

normalized_value.description: Concise normalized concept, e.g. Python, project management, 3 years.

evidence_status.description: EXPLICIT: stated in the source. EXPLICIT_NEGATIVE: the source itself says the person lacks it ("no Java experience"). UNCLEAR: mentioned but not usable (interest only, negated requirement). NOT_STATED/UNKNOWN: used in links only, never as a span record. Absence of a mention is never recorded as EXPLICIT_NEGATIVE.

source_location.description: Page, section, or paragraph reference; null if unavailable.

requirement_id.description: Identifier of the job requirement linked to this evidence, if applicable.

requirement_text.description: Relevant job requirement text, when linking CV evidence to a requirement.

years_experience.description: Only populate when explicitly supported by the source.

date_or_timeframe.description: Exact date or timeframe if stated.

context.description: Short context needed to interpret the evidence; no unsupported inference.

review_required.description: True when ambiguous, low confidence, or requiring human review.

requirement_type.description: Whether a job requirement is mandatory or preferred. Use NOT_APPLICABLE for CV-only evidence.

source_start_char.description: Zero-based inclusive character offset in the original source.

source_end_char.description: Zero-based exclusive character offset in the original source.

employment_start_date.description: Employment start date, only when supported by source evidence.

employment_end_date.description: Employment end date, or an explicitly stated current status.

degree_name.description: Degree or education qualification explicitly stated in the source.

section.description: CV section the span sits in (summary, skills, experience, education, ...), null for job text.

context_start_char.description: Start of the containing sentence (offset into the same source).

linked_requirement_ids.description: On CV records: job requirement record_ids this evidence supports.
